description: This file defines API routes and handlers for authentication flows in a FastAPI project, including OAuth login, callback, token refresh, and API key management. It contains Pydantic models for request/response schemas, route functions for OAuth and API key operations, and helper functions for token storage and encryption.

classes.name: OAuthLoginRequest
classes.description: Request model for starting an OAuth flow, includes connector type, tenant ID, connection ID, authorize URL, client ID, scopes, and optional redirect URI.

classes.name: OAuthLoginResponse
classes.description: Response model containing the authorization URL and state for OAuth login initiation.

classes.name: OAuthCallbackResponse
classes.description: Response after OAuth callback handling, includes message, connection ID, tenant ID, and optional token expiry.

classes.name: OAuthRefreshRequest
classes.description: Request model for refreshing OAuth tokens, includes tenant ID, connection ID, token URL, client credentials, and extra parameters.

classes.name: OAuthRefreshResponse
classes.description: Response after token refresh, includes message and optional new expiry timestamp.

classes.name: ApiKeyUpsertRequest
classes.description: Request to store or update an API key, includes tenant ID, connection ID, plaintext API key, and optional header name and prefix.

classes.name: ApiKeyVerifyRequest
classes.description: Request to verify an API key against stored hash, with tenant ID, connection ID, and API key.

classes.name: ApiKeyResponse
classes.description: Response indicating the result of API key operations, with a message and verification status.

classes.name: OAuthState
classes.description: TypedDict used internally for storing OAuth state details.

methods.name: _tenant_tokens_collection(tenant_id: str)
methods.description: Helper to retrieve the token records collection for a given tenant.

methods.name: bytes _aad(tenant_id: str, connection_id: str)
methods.description: Creates an encrypted associated data string to bind tokens to tenant and connection, reducing replay risk.

methods.name: Optional[datetime] _upsert_oauth_tokens( *, tenant_id: str, connection_id: str, access_token: str, refresh_token: Optional[str], expires_in: Optional[int], )
methods.description: Stores or updates OAuth tokens (access/refresh) encrypted in the database for a tenant/connection.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] _get_oauth_record(tenant_id: str, connection_id: str)
methods.description: Fetches existing OAuth token record for a tenant/connection from the database.

methods.name: None _upsert_api_key( *, tenant_id: str, connection_id: str, api_key_plain: str, header_name: Optional[str], prefix: Optional[str], )
methods.description: Stores or updates a hashed API key for a tenant/connection in the database.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] _get_api_key_record(tenant_id: str, connection_id: str)
methods.description: Fetches stored API key record for a tenant/connection.

methods.name: set_api_key(req: ApiKeyUpsertRequest)
methods.description: Placeholder for synchronous API key storage handler (to be replaced with async version).

methods.name: ApiKeyResponse verify_api_key_route(req: ApiKeyVerifyRequest, ctx: TenantContext = Depends(get_tenant_context))
methods.description: Handles verification of a provided API key against stored hash, performs audit and access control.

methods.name: OAuthLoginResponse oauth_login(req: OAuthLoginRequest, ctx: TenantContext = Depends(get_tenant_context))
methods.description: Initiates OAuth login flow by generating state, signing it, and constructing the authorization URL.

methods.name: OAuthCallbackResponse oauth_callback( request: Request, code: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="Authorization code returned by the provider."), state: str = Query(..., description="Opaque state parameter returned by the provider."), error: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="Optional error returned by provider."), error_description: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="Optional error description."), ctx: TenantContext = Depends(get_tenant_context), )
methods.description: Handles OAuth provider callback, exchanges code for tokens, encrypts and stores them, and returns success message.

methods.name: OAuthRefreshResponse oauth_refresh(req: OAuthRefreshRequest, ctx: TenantContext = Depends(get_tenant_context))
methods.description: Uses stored refresh token to obtain a new access token, updates stored tokens, and returns status.

methods.name: ApiKeyResponse set_api_key_async(req: ApiKeyUpsertRequest, ctx: TenantContext = Depends(get_tenant_context))
methods.description: Async handler to store or update an API key, including hashing and audit logging.
